verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a Cloudflare edge SDK and states it ships 4 edge SDKs alongside its client and server SDKs. It also documents the Relay Proxy, a Go application run on your own infrastructure that proxies the streaming connection to clients. A Block/Square engineer independently confirms the Relay lets you run proxies closer to your services. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of edge-SDK evaluation behavior and latency, and the pack names only Cloudflare among the edge platforms.
